FlashInfer is JIT-compiling sampling kernels with an nvcc too old for this GPU (no sm_89 / sm_90 support — pre-CUDA 11.8). Changing the attention backend does not help — flashinfer JITs the SAMPLER too. The clean fix is to set VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 so vLLM uses its native sampler instead.
Gated model. Your HF token IS being sent — but its account must be granted access first: open the model page, accept the license, and wait for approval (Meta models can take a while).

Lower quant tiers (Q2/Q3/Q4 / AWQ-4bit) are smaller, faster, and cheaper to run, at some quality loss. Higher tiers (Q8 / FP8 / FP16 / BF16) preserve more quality but need more VRAM. “All” shows the best-scoring quant per model — pick a specific one to filter.

MLX_METALLIB="$(python - <<'PY' import pathlib, sys try: import mlx except Exception as exc: raise SystemExit(f"mlx Python package is required for mlx.metallib: {exc}") root = pathlib.Path(mlx.__file__).resolve().parent for name in ("lib/mlx.metallib", "mlx.metallib", "lib/default.metallib", "default.metallib"): path = root / name if path.exists(): print(path) break else: raise SystemExit(f"No MLX metallib found under {root}") PY )"; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && cp "$MLX_METALLIB" "$HOME/.local/bin/mlx.metallib" && cp "$MLX_METALLIB" "$HOME/.local/bin/default.metallib"
